  DisequalityDispersion.Machine.InstCtx k g m →
    ∀ (f : Nat),
      LT.lt.{0} f (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.MM) →
        And
          (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
            (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS) 1) f))

              (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
            (And
              (LE.le.{0} DisequalityDispersion.Machine.IN
                (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS) 1) f)))
              (And
                (LE.le.{0}
                  (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                    (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS) 1) f)) 2)
                  (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.HP))
                (Eq.{1}
                  (m
                    (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0}
                      (m (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (HAdd.hAdd.{0, 0, 0} (m DisequalityDispersion.Machine.SYMS) 1) f)) 1))
                  (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.Instance.arityOf (DisequalityDispersion.Encoded.GInstance.base g)
                    f)))))

source.code:
theorem InstCtx.sym_rec {k : ℕ} {g : GInstance} {m : Mem} (hm : InstCtx k g m) (f : ℕ) (hf : f < m MM) :
    IN ≤ m SYMS + 1 + f ∧ m SYMS + 1 + f < m HP ∧ IN ≤ m (m SYMS + 1 + f) ∧ m (m SYMS + 1 + f) + 2 ≤ m HP ∧
      m (m (m SYMS + 1 + f) + 1) = g.base.arityOf f := by
  have hf' : f < g.base.symbols.length := by rw [← hm.mm]; exact hf
  obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4⟩ := hm.arr_syms
  rw [arrAt_length] at h3
  obtain ⟨g1, g2, _, g4⟩ := h4 f hf'
  refine ⟨by addr3, by omega, g1, g2, ?_⟩
  rw [g4]; unfold Instance.arityOf; rw [List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ hf']

lines.text: obtain ⟨g1, g2, _, g4⟩ := h4 f hf'
